<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>

## Problem
Customers are uncertain whether their Keelwater pricing plans include integrations with repair networks and unlimited document uploads. This confusion delays their purchasing decisions and risks them either underutilizing available features or overpaying for them.

## Who is affected
- Two accounts have raised this issue via the sales route [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].
- The affected accounts are Pendleford Motor Mutual and Wexmoor Motor [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].

## Evidence
- There are 2 accounts with a total ARR of £2,640,000.0 [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].
- Pendleford Motor Mutual, with an ARR of £690,000.0, asked for confirmation on whether the enterprise plan includes unlimited integrations with garage systems [i:7b19a715e7ab161d].
- Wexmoor Motor, with an ARR of £1,950,000.0, requested clarification on how pricing tiers handle third-party repair network integrations and confirmation that the annual license fee includes unlimited document uploads and supplier integrations [i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].
- The issue has been mentioned 2 times, all through the sales route [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].

## Why now
- Both inquiries were made on 2026-10-26 [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].
- Pendleford Motor Mutual's renewal date is 2027-02-28 [i:7b19a715e7ab161d].
- Wexmoor Motor's renewal date is 2027-06-30 [i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].
- No renewals have occurred in the last 90 days, indicating these are active, pre-renewal accounts seeking clarity on their current or future contracts [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].
</previous_draft>
